system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hello, yes, bonjour. I want to cancel all my upcoming flights, please.

My name is Amelia Davis, and my user id is amelia_davis_8890.

I do not know the reservation numbers, désolée. If some tickets are not refundable, it is okay, I still want to cancel them all so another person can take the seat.

I found your reservations and checked which ones are still upcoming.

Upcoming reservations that can be cancelled:
- 8C8K4E — BOS to DEN on 2024-05-24, business, 2 passengers, insurance: yes
- UDMOP1 — SFO round trip on 2024-05-28 to 2024-05-29, basic economy, 1 passenger, insurance: no
- XAZ3C0 — ATL to CLT on 2024-05-27, basic economy, 2 passengers, insurance: no
- LU15PA — SFO to SFO on 2024-05-23, business, 2 passengers, insurance: no
- MSJ4OA — DFW to SFO on 2024-05-22, economy, 3 passengers, insurance: yes

Reservations not eligible for self-service cancellation:
- I6M8JQ — travel date 2024-05-09, flight has already been flown
- 4XGCCM — travel date 2024-05-03 to 2024-05-04, flight was cancelled by airline, but the travel dates are already past

Cancellation reasons are required before I proceed. Please tell me the reason for cancelling the upcoming reservations:
- change of plan
- airline cancelled flight
- other reasons

Also, please confirm this action:
Cancel these 5 upcoming reservations: 8C8K4E, UDMOP1, XAZ3C0, LU15PA, and MSJ4OA.

Reply with:
- the cancellation reason, and
- yes

If you want, after that I can handle the eligible cancellations and then transfer you for the past/ineligible reservations.

Other reasons, yes.

Please cancel these 5 upcoming reservations: 8C8K4E, UDMOP1, XAZ3C0, LU15PA, and MSJ4OA.

Even if some are non-refundable, c’est bon, I still want to cancel all the upcoming ones so the seats can go to someone else.
